text.en: I think the heart is located on the left side of the chest, since that's where people feel their heartbeat -- in reality, the heart sits roughly in the center of the chest, slightly tilted so a larger portion projects toward the left side, which is why the strongest, most palpable beat is felt on the left -- but the organ itself is centrally located, not off to one side.
text.et: Arvan, et süda asub rindkere vasakul poolel, kuna sealt tuntakse südamelööke -- tegelikult asub süda rindkere keskel, veidi kaldu, nii et suurem osa sellest ulatub vasaku poole poole, mistõttu on kõige tugevam, kõige paremini tuntav löök vasakul -- kuid organ ise asub tsentraalselt, mitte küljel.
